findings.changed_text: Auto-post is off by default. Medium and low confidence events go to the exception queue.
findings.problem: With auto-post off by default, high-confidence events (0.95-1.00) whose category is not enabled have no defined destination. The Post bullet and the Auto-post policy send only the medium and low bands to the exception queue, so a 0.95+ event is neither auto-posted nor surfaced for review.
findings.remedy: State where high-confidence events go when auto-post is disabled or the category toggle is off, for example the exception queue as a one-tap suggested posting.

findings.changed_text: The owner or CA can flag a posted voucher for correction from the exception queue.
findings.problem: The correction section lets the CA flag posted vouchers from the exception queue, but the Phase 1 CA workflow says the CA needs no 0ledger account or workspace access. The CA therefore cannot operate the queue in Phase 1, so the actor and behavior conflict.
findings.remedy: Limit flagging to the owner in Phase 1 and route CA-requested corrections through the owner or the CA pack questions, or give the CA an explicit Phase 1 access path.

findings.problem: Why Now still presents MSME/GST market size, the 2026 AI finance funding trend, and the digital money trail as evidence without citations or hypothesis labels.
findings.remedy: Cite sources or label the claims as hypotheses.

findings.problem: What I Noticed About How You Think still calls Close Inbox 'the recommended Close Inbox,' while Approaches Considered marks Approach B as the chosen approach and A only as the fallback.
findings.remedy: Correct the wording to match the Approaches Considered section.

findings.problem: The Product shape Review bullet still lists only unmatched, low-confidence, missing-document, and tax-sensitive items, while the Exception queue also includes duplicate candidates and unbalanced or incomplete vouchers.
findings.remedy: Make the Product shape review list match the Exception queue categories.

findings.problem: What I Noticed still quotes 'manual entry into the books or excel orone,' which remains garbled and obscures the quoted evidence.
findings.remedy: Correct the quotation or paraphrase it accurately.

findings.changed_text: 5 of 5 concierge owners hand over statements without hand-holding.
findings.problem: The kill criterion triggers only when fewer than 4 of 5 concierge owners hand over statements, while success requires 5 of 5 to hand over without hand-holding. A 4-of-5 result, or 5 of 5 with hand-holding, is neither a kill nor a success, leaving the validation gate undefined in that range.
findings.remedy: Use one cohort definition and one hand-holding standard across the risk and success criteria, or define the gray-zone outcome.

findings.problem: The risk score's amount-percentile input does not define the cohort or period the percentile is measured against, so its contribution to ordering is ambiguous.
findings.remedy: Define the percentile basis, for example the event amount ranked against all events in the same close period.

findings.changed_text: 0.70 to 0.949 | Exception queue, suggested classification. Owner approves.
findings.problem: The Auto-post policy sends medium-confidence events (0.70-0.949) to the exception queue, but the Exception queue section lists only 'Low-confidence classifications' and the Product shape Review bullet also says only low-confidence, so the queue's stated contents do not match the confidence bands.
findings.remedy: Update the Exception queue and Product shape review wording to include medium-confidence suggestions, or use band labels consistently.

prior.evidence: The Auto-post policy defines the 0-1 scale, the 0.95-1.00 / 0.70-0.949 / 0.00-0.699 bands, the default off, and a global master switch plus per-category toggles.
The Correction and reversal section specifies a reversal voucher linked by reversesVoucherId, an audit event, editable drafts, flagging for correction, and readiness/CA pack regeneration.
Ask CA in Phase 1 is a local flag; the item becomes asked_ca, keeps the owner note, appears in the CA pack Questions for CA, and is sent out of band.

ClassificationRule is a persisted record with pattern, ledger/party, tax hint, confidence, priority, and enabled flag; seed rules ship and the owner can inspect, enable, disable, and edit mappings, and rule changes never rewrite posted vouchers.
MoneyEvent status values are enumerated: captured, suggested, needs_review, posted, ignored, duplicate.
CloseItem type, status, and owner values are enumerated, and each item carries an evidence field.
contentHash is added to MoneyEvent, and duplicate detection hashes the source reference, amount, date, and normalized narration.
The new tables are registered in the encrypted backup schema and covered by restore tests, and hardening tests include backup/restore of the new tables.
Why Now still presents MSME/GST market size, the 2026 AI finance funding trend, and the digital money trail without citations or hypothesis labels.
The close cockpit and product shape now show a captured GST/TDS summary and state Phase 1 does not compute a liability or set-aside; the premise and 100x thesis use captured tax position.
Build sequence uses 10 owner interviews and 5 concierge closes from that group; Success Criteria use 5 of 5 and 3 of 5; Risks use fewer than 4 of the 5; The Assignment uses 5 owners.
What I Noticed About How You Think still calls Close Inbox 'the recommended Close Inbox,' while Approaches Considered marks Approach B as the chosen approach and A only as the fallback.
The Product shape Review bullet still lists only unmatched, low-confidence, missing-document, and tax-sensitive items, omitting duplicate candidates and unbalanced or incomplete vouchers.
The risk score is defined 0-100 with confidence deficit 40, tax sensitivity 20, missing document 20, duplicate likelihood 10, amount percentile 10, thresholds at 70 and 40, and tie-breakers.
The readiness score is defined 0-100 with 40/20/20/20 weights, a blocker cap at 60, Ready/Needs review/Not ready thresholds, and a statement that it is not a filing or tax opinion.
The Phase 1 CA workflow is specified: the owner exports the pack and sends it out of band, and the CA needs no 0ledger account or workspace access.
Cash position is defined as the ledger bank/cash balance reconciled to the statement, with unreconciled lines shown separately.
The capture metric is defined as 80% of statement and attachment lines parsed into MoneyEvents without manual entry after the owner supplies the import.
What I Noticed still quotes 'manual entry into the books or excel orone,' which remains garbled.

Phase 1 capture is local .eml and attachment file import; Gmail API sync is excluded; dependencies say Gmail verification is only required if Gmail is enabled for public distribution, reconciling the no-new-network-calls claim.
